name: Wellwyrm

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The wellwyrm can breathe both air and water.

traits.name: Hunting Terror
traits.summary: Hears a creature play a horn or similar instrument: it is Frightened until the end of its next turn.
traits.text: If the wellwyrm hears a creature play a horn or a similar Musical Instrument, it has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: A venomous bite from 10 feet away: 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing plus 21 (6d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.summary: One Medium or smaller creature it sees within 5 ft: DC 16 Str save or 2d8+4 Bludgeoning and Grappled (escape DC 14) and Restrained until the grapple ends; it can move freely while holding.
actions.text: Strength save, DC 16, for one Medium or smaller creature the wellwyrm can see within 5 feet. Failure: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14) and Restrained until the grapple ends. The wellwyrm pays no extra movement for moving while it holds someone.

summary: A fey-twisted serpent that ambushes from wells and burrows, bites with venom, and coils around a victim to drag them away.
